signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation in August 2025 and is hiring hundreds across sales

email.body1:
Frankie, saw EliseAI closed its $250M Series E and is hiring hundreds, including sales.

Scaling an SDR team that fast usually means follow-up volume balloons faster than new reps can ramp, and good leads sit too long before anyone touches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations, not the queue: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to EliseAI's top three accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Frankie, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

During a hiring surge, ramp time and response speed are usually what cap booked meetings, not effort. New reps take months to sound credible, and by then in-market accounts have gone quiet.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent, without adding to your team's workload.
email.body3:
Frankie, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Frankie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and ramp isn't a priority while you build out the team, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know hiring hundreds is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a scaling SDR team? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
